title: Phase 76 adds cross-case learning, portfolio governance, and policy-retirement controls
summary: Eight inactive institutional-learning dossiers, all twenty-eight pairwise transfer reviews, six inactive portfolio-governance registers, and eight inactive policy-retirement ledgers now expose how lessons, shared dependencies, cumulative burden, supersession, and decommissioning would be reviewed. Eight new guides and three maps deepen the content layer without creating conclusions.
evidence_note: This release contains empty learning, comparison, portfolio, supersession, retirement, decommissioning, and archive contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It does not contain an independently audited Phase 75 decision, admitted lesson, institutional-memory memo, comparable pair, transfer finding, non-transfer finding, bounded reuse decision, shared-dependency finding, cumulative-burden finding, portfolio decision, policy supersession, retirement, decommissioning action, closure receipt, score, or ranking.
publication_effect: Adds eight Published briefings, three Published dependency maps, one searchable registry with fifty detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence, cohort, stage, result, synthesis, decision, implementation, impact, and operating states unchanged.
